$comment: Both scripts read this file, so the synchronization logic itself contains no
project-specific paths. To adopt this mechanism in another project, copy the
two scripts plus this file and edit ONLY the values below.
Paths are relative to the repository root (the parent of scripts/) and use
$comment_strip: stripFrontmatter: remove a leading YAML '---' block from the generated file.
stripCalloutStartsWith: drop a blockquote callout whose first line starts with
this text, plus its continuation lines. Empty string disables it.
stripFromHeading: drop this heading and everything after it. Empty disables it.
stripCalloutStartsWith: > [!important] This file is the canonical CLAUDE.md
